traits.name: Three Day Rule
traits.result_text: Carried as a hard bound on every stay: the ability's clock runs out when the stay does.

traits.name: Witness Stance
traits.result_text: Carried: watching comes first, and the ability never starts a fight.

traits.name: Quick Draw
traits.result_text: Carried: speed is what lets one volley cover many hands.

traits.name: Survival Craft
traits.reason: A general road skill the authored rule does not use.

traits.name: Road Companion
traits.reason: A separate being, not a trait; the rule needs no companion.

traits.name: Traveler Limits
traits.result_text: Carried: no allies and no resources beyond what the user can carry.

traits.name: Angel Arm
traits.reason: Its output cannot be tuned to a volley of disabling shots; this design uses only handgun precision.

traits.name: Arm Output Limit
traits.reason: The limit belongs to the arm, which is not carried.

traits.name: Pacifist Vow
traits.result_text: Carried as a hard bound: no setting of the volley is lethal.

traits.name: Sharpshooting
traits.result_text: Precision in disabling shots becomes the aimed, simultaneous disabling of every armed hand.

emergent_ability.name: Quiet Volley
emergent_ability.description: After watching a dispute long enough to read who holds what and how each will move, the user ends it with one fast, precise volley that strips every weapon from every armed hand without killing anyone.

governing_rule.description: Time spent watching a dispute teaches the user which hands hold weapons and in what order they will move; one fast volley then disables every weapon in a single breath, the vow keeps every shot non-lethal, and the three-day rule forces the user to leave before the place can adapt.

emergent_ability.activation: Sustained observation of a dispute, with the user not yet committed to either side.
limitations: Needs watching first: without time spent observing a dispute, the volley cannot be aimed and does not fire.
It only reaches weapons held in a hand; it cannot stop a threat that is not held, such as gas, fire or a locked room.
Past a handful of armed targets, one volley cannot disable them all and is not attempted.
The vow bounds it: no setting is lethal, so it cannot end a fight that only a lethal shot would end.
The three-day rule applies: the user must leave before the third day ends, so a dispute that outlasts the stay is left unresolved.

inherited_limitations.name: Pacifist Vow
inherited_limitations.description: Refuses to take a life, even an enemy's.

inherited_limitations.name: Three Day Rule
inherited_limitations.description: Never stays in any one country longer than three days.

exclusions.item: the talking motorcycle as a carried companion
exclusions.reason: A separate being, not a trait.

exclusions.item: the episodic structure of visiting one country at a time

exclusions.reason: The arm is not carried, so no setting releases it.
A reputation is a narrative role, not a transferable mechanic.
